_readme: Dashboard configuration. Edit, then refresh the browser — nothing to rebuild.
HOW A COLUMN IS DEFINED — each entry in `columns` reads left to right:
column    : the column name in imm_data.xlsx (this is what supplies the values)
analytics : which analytics group it belongs to — this sets the header colour
header    : the name shown on the dashboard ( | starts a new header line )
format    : how the value is rendered
The order of `columns` is the order shown on the dashboard. Delete a line to
drop that column; move a line to move the column.
FORMATS   text  plain text          musd  USD millions   13,609M
pct1  percent, 1 dp  1.3%  num2  2 decimals     1.22
int   whole number    387  tick  green tick when the value is 1
OPTIONAL PER COLUMN
width     : relative column width (default depends on format)
align     : left | center | right (default: first column left, tick centred, rest right)
total     : sum | wavg | none — how the red Total row is computed
(default: musd sums, other numbers are AUM-weighted, text/tick blank)
showWhen  : { "<xlsx column>": value } — render the cell only when this matches
SORTING   click a header to sort by that column alone; click it again to flip.
SHIFT-CLICK a header to add it as a further sort key (▼ then ▲ then
removed). A small number on the arrow shows the key's priority.
Blanks always sort last. `table.defaultSort` sets the opening order
and accepts either one { column, direction } or a list of them.
TABLE BLOCK
aggregation     : wavg — averages weighted by dataset.weightColumn (AUM)
avg  — plain arithmetic mean
Sets the default for every numeric column; a column's own
`total` (sum | avg | wavg | none) still wins.
defaultSort     : { "column": "<xlsx column>", "direction": "asc" | "desc" }
or [ {...}, {...} ] for a multi-column default
pageSize        : rows per page at load — a number, or "all"
pageSizeOptions : choices offered in the Rows per Page picker
The Total row always covers every mandate in the selection, not just the page.
PER GROUP — every entry in `groups` may override the two lines above it:
columns   : the xlsx column names this group shows, in display order
analytics : { "esg": false } to hide a type, or
{ "esg": { "colour": "#7A9AA8", "label": "Carbon" } }
title     : heading text (default: derived from the group name)
A group with no overrides shows the full `columns` list above.

dataset._note: Which imm_data.xlsx columns drive the page furniture.
